# ChimeraMiND Data

> Public WebDataTools Actor catalog. Input, pricing and limits should be checked before any paid run.

## Connect

- [Apify MCP documentation](https://docs.apify.com/mcp): OAuth, discovery and execution.
- [Apify CLI reference](https://docs.apify.com/cli/docs/reference)
- [Catalog manifest](https://data.chimeramind.com/distribution-manifest.json): generated page links, not a runtime API.
